alt: Each project folder under examples/ (code_embedding, paper_metadata, text_embedding) has its Python files read by gemini-2.5-flash through instructor and LiteLLM into a CodebaseInfo record, then merged into one Markdown wiki page per project; output/code_embedding.md lists app_main, process_file and process_chunk as CocoIndex functions and draws the pipeline app_main ==> process_file --> process_chunk, and editing code_embedding/main.py rewrites only that page.
needs: GEMINI_API_KEY (or LLM_MODEL with its provider key)

run.note: Write one wiki page per project in ../ to output/
